description: This source file implements the CapabilityReportingTask class, which handles various capability reporting and query messages in a multi-vendor Wi-Fi management context. It constructs and sends capability report messages, manages TLVs for different Wi-Fi features, and interacts with a database of radios and device configurations.

classes.name: CapabilityReportingTask
classes.description: Handles capability reporting and query messages, constructs capability reports, and manages TLVs for Wi-Fi features.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming CMDU messages and dispatches to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: handle_client_capability_query
methods.description: Handles client capability query messages and responds with capability reports.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles internal events such as early AP capability report creation.

methods.name: create_early_ap_capability_report_message
methods.description: Constructs and sends an early AP capability report message.

methods.name: add_akm_suites_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds AKM suite capabilities TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_wifi7_agent_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds WiFi 7 agent capabilities TLV based on radio capabilities.

methods.name: handle_ap_capability_query
methods.description: Handles AP capability query messages and responds with capability reports.

methods.name: prepare_ap_capability_message
methods.description: Prepares the AP capability report message with various TLVs.

methods.name: handle_backhaul_sta_capability_query
methods.description: Handles backhaul STA capability query messages and responds with capabilities.

methods.name: add_ap_ht_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HT capabilities TLV for a given radio interface.

methods.name: add_ap_vht_capabilities
methods.description: Adds VHT capabilities TLV for a given radio interface.

methods.name: add_ap_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HE capabilities TLV for a given radio interface.

methods.name: add_ap_wifi6_capabilities
methods.description: Adds Wi-Fi 6 capabilities TLV for a given radio interface.

methods.name: add_ap_radio_advanced_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds advanced radio capabilities TLV for a given radio interface.

methods.name: add_cac_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds CAC capabilities TLV based on current CAC configuration.

methods.name: add_device_inventory_tlv
methods.description: Adds device inventory TLV with serial number, software version, and radios info.

methods.name: add_profile2_ap_capability_tlv
methods.description: Adds profile 2 AP capability TLV with configuration details.
